pixel.label: Pixel-art intro deck
pixel.prompt: Build a 6-slide product intro deck in a pixel-game style with bold, playful colors

launch.label: Product launch
launch.prompt: Build a 10-slide launch keynote — a strong opening and a clear call to action at the end

defense.label: Thesis defense
defense.prompt: Build a thesis defense deck covering background, method, results and conclusion

report.label: Quarterly review
report.prompt: Turn this quarter's progress into an 8-slide review deck focused on data and takeaways

landing.label: Product landing page
landing.prompt: Design a SaaS landing page, dark theme, with a sharp value proposition above the fold

mobile.label: Mobile home screen
mobile.prompt: Design the home screen of a budgeting app — card layout, light and airy

poster.label: Event poster
poster.prompt: Design a poster for an offline tech meetup with clear hierarchy and a striking key visual

dashboard.label: Analytics dashboard
dashboard.prompt: Design an operations dashboard with key metric cards and trend charts

market.label: Market landscape
market.prompt: Research the 2026 market landscape for AI coding assistants — key players, positioning and business models

tech.label: Technology comparison
tech.prompt: Compare Postgres, MySQL and SQLite as the backend database for a small-to-mid SaaS product, and recommend one with reasons

policy.label: Policy and compliance
policy.prompt: Map out the filing and compliance requirements for shipping a generative AI product, and how long each step takes

compare.label: Competitor breakdown
compare.prompt: Compare Notion, Obsidian and Craft on positioning, core capabilities and pricing, and say which fits which use case

outage.label: Service outage
outage.prompt: The platform was unreachable and alerts failed to send from 23:05 last night to 01:10 today; device-side collection kept working and all data has been backfilled. Write a notice for all customers.

dataloss.label: Unrecoverable data gap
dataloss.prompt: Data from some sensors between 14:00 and 18:00 on July 20 was lost and cannot be backfilled. Write a customer-facing statement usable as a deviation attachment in their audit.

falsealarm.label: False alarms
falsealarm.prompt: The system sent a dozen duplicate false alarms this morning while the actual readings were normal. Write a short notice for the affected customers.

missedalarm.label: Missed alarms
missedalarm.prompt: Alarm notifications failed to go out between 14:00 and 17:00 yesterday; we are still checking whether any threshold was breached. Write a notice and ask customers to review that window.

partyb.label: Review as Party B
partyb.prompt: Review this contract from Party B's side, focusing on payment schedule, acceptance criteria and liability. Give risk ratings and a negotiation priority list.

partya.label: Review as Party A
partya.prompt: Review this contract from Party A's side, focusing on delivery scope, IP ownership and data security clauses.

pitfall.label: Find unfavourable terms
pitfall.prompt: What are the traps in this contract? List every clause that works against us, rate the severity, and suggest rewrites.

missing.label: Detect missing clauses
missing.prompt: Which standard clauses is this contract missing (confidentiality, dispute resolution, force majeure, termination)? Draft the missing ones.
